title.narrative: Programa de Atencin Integral al Menor

description.narrative: THE OPERATION IS AN INTEGRAL PART OF A NATIONAL PROGRAM OF SERVICES FOR CHILDREN UNDER SIX YEARS OF AGE. THE MAIN FOCUS OF THE PROGRAM IS TO: (I) SUPPORT THE INSTITUTIONAL ORDERING AND STRENGTHENING OF THE SECTOR IN ORDER TO INCREASE THE EFFICIENCY AND EFECTIVENESS OF THE USE OF THE RESOURCES; (II) IMPROVE THE COVERAGE AND QUALITY OF THE SERVICES OFFERED IN THE RURAL AREA. THE LATTER WILL COMPRISE A MENU OF ALTERNATIVES THAT ARE BASED ON SUCCESSFUL EXPERIENCES IN THE COUNTRY.
